content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect assumption about the state of the `Link` object when the link carrier was detected. Specifically, the code was trying to access the `network` property of the `Link` object when it was in the `LINK_STATE_INITIALIZED` state, which may not have been fully initialized. The patch corrects the state checks to ensure that the operations are only performed when the link is in the appropriate states (`LINK_STATE_CONFIGURING` or `LINK_STATE_CONFIGURED`), preventing assertions from failing due to uninitialized properties.
